title: Ing lagyung binie na bayu ya mibait
intro: Isipan me ing tahimik a santuaryu a mitmung masipag a pamanalangin kaybat ning makabang banuang pamag-abang. Manibat keng e mayayakit datang ing pakibat a magdalang lagyung e pa mipagkalub kanitang minuna, mangaku yang kabiasnan manibat kareng minunang banua at bie a makamarka king debosyon, lunus, at kalinisan.
clues: Pemalagyuan naku ning Allah mismu bayu ku mibait, a alang lagyung binie na ning ninu man bayu ku mibait.
mipagkalub ku bilang pakibat keng masipag a pamanalangin da reng matwang pengari na aisip da na ing anak e ya malyari.
Dininan na kung kabiasnan, pamanatul, at ing Kasulatan inyang malati ku pa.
Meging katungkulan ku kareng pengari ku at mapaglunus ku kareng aliwa, at e ku mayabang o e mapamintu.
Ing Allah binie na ing kapayapan kanaku keng aldo ning pangabait ku, ing aldo ning pangamate ku, ampo ing aldo ning pangasubling mebie ku.
I tatang kung i Zakariyya tinggap ne ing masayang balita tungkul kanaku ibat kareng anghel kabang makatalakad yang manalangin keng santuaryu (mihrab).

trial.label: Bendisyun at Kapagsubukan
options: Melaklak ya keng maragul a asan para meko ya keng mua
Miyugse la king milalablab a api ban siran la ding idolo
E ya mipaintulutan tuknangan at likuan neng patubuan ning metung a babaing lobo
Mipagkalub kareng matwang pengari kaybat ning masipag a pamanalangin
Inarapan ne i Faraon at menimuna yang pamaglakbe papunta king dayatmalat
trial.answer: Mipagkalub kareng matwang pengari kaybat ning masipag a pamanalangin

location.label: Lugar a Susi
options: Ing santuaryu (mihrab) nung nukarin la mipabalu deng masayang balita
Ing milalablab a api a sidia da ring sasamba karing idolo
Ing atian ning mangaragul a asan king malalam a dagat
Ing kueba nung nukarin la migpainawa deng matudtud kilub ning dakal a siglu
Ing lambak da reng panas keng metung a royal march
location.answer: Ing santuaryu (mihrab) nung nukarin la mipabalu deng masayang balita

outcome.label: Divinung Parangal
options: Pepalto ibat banua kareng batu a gawa keng lutung gabun
Melaklak yang mabie ning yatu uli ning kayabangan king pibandian
mesira ya keng masikan a sabog para keng gulut ning babaing kamelyu
linub ya keng metung a mayabang a host keng makabukud a dagat
Kapayapan kanaku king aldo a mibait ku, king aldo a mate ku, at king aldo a subli kung mabie
outcome.answer: Kapayapan kanaku king aldo a mibait ku, king aldo a mate ku, at king aldo a subli kung mabie

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
